findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false. Long-lived, non-rotated key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and violates common compliance baselines for audit log encryption keys.

No policy attribute is defined, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy that delegates full key access to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions to use or administer the key. For a key protecting audit trail data this fails least privilege and provides no separation between key administrators and log readers.
